name: Writing & Editing
description: Rewrite, polish, shorten, expand and restructure any text

prompts.title: Rewrite for Tone
prompts.description: Rewrite text in a specific tone for a specific audience
prompts.content:
Rewrite the text below in a {{tone}} tone for {{audience}}. Keep the original meaning and all facts. Return only the rewritten text, no commentary.

{{text}}

input.text: I am writing to inform you that the report you requested has now been completed and is attached.

examples.output: Hi — the report you asked for is done and attached. Let me know if you'd like any changes.

prompts.title: Proofread & Polish
prompts.description: Fix grammar, spelling and clarity, then list what changed
prompts.content:
Proofread and polish the text below. Fix grammar, spelling, punctuation and awkward phrasing while preserving my voice and meaning.

Return two sections:
1. The corrected text
2. A short bullet list of the notable changes you made

{{text}}

variables.name: text
variables.example: Paste the text that needs checking

prompts.title: Shorten & Tighten
prompts.description: Cut text to a target length without losing the point
prompts.content:
Tighten the text below to about {{target_length}}. Remove filler and repetition, keep every key point and the original tone. Return only the shortened text.

{{text}}

prompts.title: Expand from an Outline
prompts.description: Turn bullet points or a rough outline into finished prose

variables.name: outline
variables.description: Your bullet points or rough notes
variables.example:
- problem
- our approach
- why it matters

prompts.title: Summarize into Key Points
prompts.description: Condense any text into clear bullet points
prompts.content:
Summarize the text below into {{count}} clear bullet points for {{audience}}. Lead with the most important information.

{{text}}

prompts.title: Extract Structured Data
prompts.description: Pull specific fields out of messy text into a clean format
prompts.content:
From the text below, extract the following fields: {{fields}}. Output as {{output_format}}. If a field is missing, write "n/a" — do not guess.

{{text}}

input.text: Hi, this is Dana from Northwind. We'd love a quote — our budget is around 8k.

examples.output:
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| name | Dana |
| company | Northwind |
| budget | ~8,000 |

prompts.title: Title & Headline Ideas
prompts.description: Generate a batch of title options in a chosen style
prompts.content: Give me {{count}} {{style}} title options for {{topic}}. Keep each under {{max_length}}. Vary the angle (curiosity, benefit, how-to, contrarian) and add a one-line note on who each would appeal to.

variables.name: topic
variables.example: a guide to saving for retirement

prompts.title: Change the Reading Level
prompts.description: Rewrite text for a simpler or more advanced reader
prompts.content:
Rewrite the text below for a {{reading_level}} reader. Keep all the key information accurate, adjust vocabulary and sentence length, and avoid talking down to the reader. Return only the rewritten text.

{{text}}
